note: Ratchet for the structural code report (`./gradlew :worker:structureReport`). Every number below is production code that ships and does nothing: classes nothing references, methods only tests call, methods no entry point can reach, methods too big for the JIT, and severe in-loop cost findings. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the task. The task prints the tightened set whenever the tree improves; paste it here in the same commit.
measured: 2026-08-05 on the full tree. Tightened by the region-hashing pass (Plan 10): the speculative diagnostic accessors that pass added were deleted rather than budgeted for, and the sweep took nine more with them — ChunkStamp#differsFrom, ChunkStampBook#clear/clock, HybridClock#node, Hlc#of, MutationGuard#mode, EncryptedRegion#piece, PieceDownloader#completion, ContentTransferService#manifestOf — plus ProposalManager's three and ReliabilityScorer's two, all of which section 2.3 reported as referenced by nothing at all, tests included. severe_cost_findings returns to 4 because WorldArchiveService#withLateArrivals no longer scans its holder list inside its own loop: the membership test now uses a set, which matters precisely when a fetch is struggling and the holder set is growing.
